releaseTitle: ATalk v3.3.0 — WhatsApp-Grade 2G Low-Network Messaging, VoIP Resilience & Pure Master PIN Security
releaseNotes:
• Pure Master PIN Security: Removed all fingerprint options and biometric unlock vectors from app settings, vault setup, and stealth notes triggers to eliminate unauthorized lock-screen access on shared devices. Hidden vault is strictly protected by 6-digit Master PIN and stealth triggers.
• WhatsApp-Grade 2G Low-Network Messaging: Optimized polling with incremental delta sync (<300 bytes payload) and persistent HTTP/2 connection pooling with keep-alive to eliminate slow TLS handshakes on EDGE/2G.
• Ultra-Low Bandwidth VoIP Calling: Adaptive Opus audio compression down to 12 kbps, in-band Forward Error Correction (FEC), DTX silence suppression, and live weak-network status indicators.
